title: Client Bench Agent: Local Provenance + Shielded Telemetry for Dedicated/Private
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Build a lightweight, customer-scoped Benchmarking Agent that runs locally in Dedicated and Private deployment footprints to produce provenance-linked quality signals and privacy-preserving telemetry. The Agent must enable per-client regression detection tied to configuration or model changes (model rollouts, quantization profile swaps, batching/prefetch changes) while keeping raw prompts and responses on the customer side. Goal: prevent downstream regressions from rolling out to production customers and give clear, actionable delta reports to customers and Redwood SRE/PM teams without exposing PII or proprietary corpora.
design_decisions: Run evaluation harness inside customer VPC (private deployment) or within Dedicated GPU pool under customer tenancy to keep raw data in-scope.
Use salted HMAC anchors for golden reference matching so Redwood can verify identical inputs across tenants without receiving the plaintext.
Collect only aggregated delta metrics and cryptographic hashes for remote telemetry; absolute token content never leaves customer boundary unless explicitly allowed by customer opt-in.
Implement an on-agent lightweight delta-scoring library that computes BLEU-like, embedding-distance, and custom business heuristics, then reduces to compact signed vectors for reporting.
Expose a server-side ‘gate evaluator’ that ingests shielded telemetry and decides automatic rollback thresholds per policy (customer-configurable).
acceptance_criteria: Agent can be deployed in a Dedicated tenant and on a Private VPC with installation docs and helm/terraform snippets.
Local evaluation run completes end-to-end on a sample golden set and returns a signed delta report (<= 50KB) that a Redwood console can interpret.
Telemetry payloads do not contain raw prompt/response text and are verifiable via HMAC anchors.
A model/config rollout can be blocked automatically when delta exceeds the configured threshold in at least one monitored metric.
Performance overhead: evaluation runs must not consume more than 5% of production serving GPU budget for Dedicated pools during background runs.
Security review completed and KMS integration for signing anchors validated.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Clients will be wary of any telemetry even if hashed. Mitigation: provide an ‘airgap proof’ demo and sop for cryptographic verification and offer on-prem-only mode with no external callbacks.

Risk: Evaluation noise from synthetic augmentation can produce false positives. Mitigation: provide multi-metric consensus (embedding + task-specific heuristics) and a sliding window before firing rollbacks.
Risk: GPU contention on Dedicated capacity. Mitigation: schedule low-priority background runs and allow admin-configurable throttles and sampling ratios.
Risk: Complexity of per-customer policies. Mitigation: ship sane defaults and a guest template library for common enterprise rules (finance, healthcare, regulated).
